title: Segmentation and Classification Algorithm for CNT Quantification
content: Electron Microscopy in Materials Science applications often involves image segmentation and classification as a precondition for detailed analysis. With the development of sophisticated and specific application machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques, the possibility of using the said techniques to produce high throughput analysis is feasible. A variety of applications have been developed using segmentation models such as μSAM (for biological cell segmentation) [1], MaskFormer (for semantic segmentation) [2], U-Net (for biomedical image segmentation) [3], DeepLab (for semantic segmentation with scene understanding) [4] and ENet (for real-time semantic segmentation) [5] to name a few.
